# Ting 0.7.6
## New
- **Clipbawd, a clipboard history.** Search for Clipbawd in launcha, use its optional hotkey (Settings › Clipbawd), a selecta binding (`"open": "clipbawd"`) or **Open Clipbawd** in Ting's menu. Search on top, the items of this session on the left, newest first, and a preview of the selected item on the right: the text, the image, the files or the color, with its type, source app, length or size, image dimensions and format, and when it was copied. `Return` pastes the item into the app in front, `⌘Return` copies it, `⇧⌘⌫` removes it. Search also understands text typed with the wrong keyboard layout. - Copying the same thing again moves it to the top and counts it (`×3`) instead of adding it twice. When an app puts a picture of the copied text next to it, as Word does, clipbawd keeps the text. - **This session only.** The history stays in memory, up to 200 items by default, and is gone when Ting quits. - **Off if you do not want it.** Turn off **Use Clipbawd** in Settings › Clipbawd (`"enabled": false`): Ting stops reading the clipboard, forgets the history, frees the hotkey and removes the menu item. - **What is never kept:** copies while Secure Keyboard Entry is on, copies that password managers mark as secret, copies from Firefox private windows it recognises (requires Accessibility and a matching window title) and, after you allow it, Chrome, Brave, Edge and Vivaldi incognito windows. Add apps to **Never keep copies from** with **Never Keep from…** in clipbawd or in Settings, and list text starts such as `sk-` or `ghp_` under **Never keep text that starts with**. Safari does not tell other apps about its private windows. - **Link previews, off by default.** With **Fetch link titles, icons and images** on, a copied link shows its page title and favicon, or the image and its size for an image link. Ting sends one plain GET without cookies or scripts and checks for local network addresses before fetching. DNS results are not pinned to the connection; keep previews off where DNS rebinding is a concern. - **Window bindings.** A selecta binding can open launcha or clipbawd: `{"key": "v", "open": "clipbawd"}`. Add one from **+** in Settings › Bindings.
- **History in micro-apps.** Approved templates can read `${clipboard[-1]}` for the newest entry or `${clipboard[-2]}` for the preceding entry. A snapshot stays fixed for the run. Text, links and colors give text; files give newline-separated paths. Images, missing entries and unavailable history fail explicitly. Shell steps must use `env:`, not interpolate history into code. The approval panel warns about history access. Headless runs cannot read Ting’s session history. - Single-click selects an item for preview; double-click or Return pastes it.
## Upgrade
A downloaded copy: choose **Check for Updates…** in Ting. A Homebrew copy: choose **Update Ting via Homebrew…** in Ting's menu. Settings, bindings, micro-apps and permissions are preserved. Requires macOS 14 or later; the signed, notarized and stapled universal app supports Apple Silicon and Intel.
